statements.subject: client
statements.description: Client Implementations SHOULD: Prefer new names immediately for all new integrations.
actions: Prefer new names immediately for all new integrations

statements.subject: client
statements.description: Client Implementations SHOULD: Implement dual-handling where schemas/types permit (e.g., union type or backward-compatible decoder).
actions: Implement dual-handling where schemas/types permit (e.g., union type or backward-compatible decoder)

statements.subject: client
statements.description: Client Implementations SHOULD: Log a warning when receiving legacy-named objects after the first deprecation announcement release.
actions: Log a warning when receiving legacy-named objects after the first deprecation announcement release

statements.subject: server
statements.description: Server Implementations MAY: Accept both legacy and current request message forms during the overlap period.
actions: Accept both legacy and current request message forms during the overlap period

statements.subject: server
statements.description: Server Implementations MAY: Emit only current form in responses (recommended) while providing explicit upgrade notes.
actions: Emit only current form in responses
Provide explicit upgrade notes to consumers

statements.subject: server
statements.description: Breaking: The kind field is no longer part of the protocol and should not be emitted
actions: Omit the kind field from all emitted protocol objects
